messages:
jamie: FYI incident 2112 is resolved. We need a PIR/retro to capture root cause and actions. Who can host/facilitate next week? Prefer 60m. TL;DR: mass cache evictions + fallback routing triggered during a traffic spike.

incident-bot: Incident #2112 resolved at 2026-03-09T14:12:03Z — pages: #sre-oncall, #infra. Summary: prefix eviction cascade caused elevated latencies; recommended PIR.

maria: I can facilitate if no one else. I have the facilitation template and slides. Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PST.

ravi: I can attend but I'm on support Tue morning. I can host Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC if that helps (works for EU folks).

sylvie: Wed is tight for me. Thu 15:00 UTC looks good. Also would like product & infra PMs there — cc @ben @lara.

ben: Product wants a short pre-read + impact bullets. I can compile that.

jamie: Thanks — Maria if you host, want help with timeline and SLO graphs? I can assemble logs + tracing.

maria: Yes please. jamie can you paste the perf queries you're using? Also need the rollout diff and canary config.

jamie: here's the query I'm running for the P95 graph:
```
SELECT minute, p95_latency_ms, token_count
FROM infra.metrics
WHERE incident_id = 2112
ORDER BY minute
LIMIT 180
```

ravi: Quick question — should the facilitator run an ops drill during PIR or stick to findings + actions?

maria: Proposed agenda (short):
```
- 5m intro & goals
- 15m timeline (jamie)
- 20m RCA + config root causes (infra)
- 10m customer impact (ben)
- 10m actions & owners
- 5m followups / next steps
```

sylvie: :thumbsup: Looks good. Add 'rollback thresholds' to actions.

ben: I'll draft the pre-read today and ping product. Pre-read link will go to: https://cal.redwood.team/2112-pre-read

jamie: Let's poll times — react with :one: for Wed 09:30 UTC, :two: for Thu 15:00 UTC. I'll tally.

incident-bot: Poll created: "PIR for incident 2112" — react in thread.

maria: :two: (prefer Thu)

ravi: :one:

sylvie: :two:

jamie: Tally so far: Wed 1, Thu 2 -> Thu 15:00 UTC wins. I'll send the calendar invite and include the usual attendees (maria, ravi, sylvie, ben, lara, ops-oncall).

ben: I'll own the pre-read + product impact summary. Also I'll take runbook updates after the PIR (volunteering for runbook change owner).

maria: Great. Current action owners: timeline/logs - jamie; pre-read - ben; facilitator - maria; runbook update - ben. I'll add labels and assignees in the PIR doc.

jamie: Ops — can we get a KV cache dump attached to the PIR doc? @ops-bot can you run cache dump for incident_2112 and upload artifact?

ops-bot: Scheduled job queued: cache-dump incident_2112 -> /artifacts/2112/cache-dump.tar.gz. ETA ~7m.

maria: thanks. I'll wait for artifact then post invite + doc link.

ops-bot: Done. Artifact uploaded: https://s3.redwood/2112/cache-dump.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

jamie: Closing loop — calendar invite sent for Thu 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC (Invite id: cal_2112_3). Doc + pre-read: https://cal.redwood.team/2112-pre-read. See you all there.
